preservation: No new source data, downloads, old-file edits, or protected dates opened. No tuning after results.

probes.affine: All 1484 Jan-Jul anchors, 256 identical closes: center on last log close in float64 then multiply by10000 before float32 inference. Compare with saved uncentered forecasts. Absolute point changes above0.1bps are flagged, not used to select a model.
probes.negative: 128 independent Gaussian random walks sigma0.002/hour seed20261026; zero is the known population conditional mean/median. A finite sample can favor either model. 256past+24future points, horizons4/24.
probes.overlap: Describe lag1 versus lag-h autocorrelation of rolling h-hour returns, and associations of saved forecasts with past returns and future outcomes. Overlap autocorrelation is not forecast skill.
probes.positive: Constant, positive/negative linear trend (0.0002/hour), four phase64-hour sinusoids amplitude0.01, each at4/24h; judge constant within0.1bps and trend/sine aggregate MAE against last price, with all individual outcomes retained.
probes.scoring: Separate 5/95 percent tail loss and interval score from 50 percent median loss; also match static median to the existing zero point. No original forecasts modified.

status: diagnostic on previously observed history; no independent validation or model selection
